chat.author: Christian Amsüss
chat.text: I'm not set up to send audio, Paul or Barry should have been here (me just listening in from vacation). But I don't hear any audio either, so maybe I just get wrong data (joining from mobile on a flaky connection)

chat.author: Paul Hoffman
chat.text: My deep apologies. I'm here now.

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: Hello, I was also late due to life.

chat.author: Christian Amsüss
chat.text: No audio for me today beyond few-second chunks. Sorry for not facilitating anything today.

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: vacations should be taken when the weather is nice... nice and cold and with good ski conditions :-)

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: Cunningham's Law: best way to get an answer on the Internet is to post the wrong answer.  So, an assertion like Paul said, "This does not seem to be going well", might elicit disagreement... use the Cunningham.

chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text: Thank you Joe!   Summary of state of debate is really useful!

chat.author: Вадим Гончаров
chat.text: I have procedural question about note-taking: nobody did it today, may be meetecho will support AI-automatic transcripts?
